extra.final_summary: Problems found: 1) 'species' column had label variants (adelie, chinstrap, gentoo, Gentto) that were normalized to standard values. 2) 'body_mass_g' was stored as text with commas and needed casting to numeric. 3) Two rows (2, 50) had invalid flipper_length_mm values (-190, -195) below the minimum of 170; these were excluded. 4) One row (39) had an impossible body_mass_g value of 4,150,000 grams (over 4 tons); this was excluded. All fixes applied. The average body mass is 3,701.39g for Adelie, 3,754.55g for Chinstrap, and 5,081.58g for Gentoo penguins.
